name: Gurgaon (AKT-GD-079)
short_desc: The Akyoto GSM Auto Dialer is a fast and reliable alerting solution that sends instant voice calls and SMS notifications during fire, intrusion, or emergency events to ensure immediate response and safety.
description:
The Akyoto GSM Auto Dialer (AKT-GD-079) is an advanced 4G/2G technology–based emergency communication device designed to deliver real-time alerts for critical situations across offices, factories, residences, commercial premises, and industrial sites. Compatible with all major telecom operators, it ensures ultra-fast and dependable communication when emergencies occur.

The device is programmed to send automatic voice calls and SMS alerts to predefined mobile numbers in the event of fire, theft, intrusion, robbery, or disaster scenarios. Recorded voice messages and customizable SMS notifications provide clear and immediate information, enabling quicker decision-making and response from security teams or property owners.

Highly flexible and user-friendly, the GSM Auto Dialer can be configured and managed via an Android app or simple SMS commands, eliminating the need for constant internet connectivity. It supports multiple alarm inputs, integrates seamlessly with intrusion alarm panels, fire alarm systems, DVRs, NVRs, and access control systems, and allows easy editing of contact numbers and messages.

Operating on 12V or 24V DC power supply, the AKT-GD-079 is a powerful automation and security accessory that enhances emergency preparedness. By ensuring timely alerts and effective communication, it helps protect life, property, and valuable assets, making it an essential component of modern security and fire safety systems.

name: Akyoto Security Alarm Systems HSL-077
description:
• Dedicated smartphone application
    • Being a modern Akyoto HSL077 alarm system, it can send notifications and alerts directly to the smartphone, and it can be controlled and configured with the help of dedicated applications: It is available for both Android and iOS smartphones. Thus, no matter where you are, you will be notified instantly by the system if an event occurs. Complete system ready to use
    • The Akyoto HSL077 wireless alarm system contains all accessories for immediate installation and use. The package contains 1 wireless motion sensor, 1 wireless door sensor, 2 remote controls, and an indoor siren for 90 dB sound alerting.

    Total protection of the home

    • The system offers total protection of the home, offering the user total control and real-time monitoring of the system and recorded events. The dedicated smartphone application and the menu available on the central unit provide easy and intuitive real-time information, both locally and remotely, about the alerts and events recorded for each type of sensor installed. We add to this category the function of real-time audio monitoring and communication with the protected area, through the GSM connection.

    Full range of compatible accessories

    In addition to the usual accessories and motion and door/window sensors, Akyoto completes the range of optional accessories with the following products, necessary in a modern home:

    • Akyoto wireless motion sensor;
    • Akyoto wireless smoke sensor
    • Akyoto wireless gas sensor;
    • Akyoto remote control;
    • Akyoto wireless magnetic contact;

    Different areas depending on the objective and destination
    Each area or room in a house needs a different and dedicated sensor for a certain event. In this way, we can configure the parameters of a sensor in such a way that we know at any time if a window or a door has been opened, if smoke, gas or water has been detected, or if movement has been detected in a certain room.
    Thus, we have predefined names in the configuration for each added sensor: door, window, bedroom, living room, balcony, perimeter, fire, gas, or flood.
    We also have predefined zone types for each added sensor: perimeter, total, 24 hours, bell, closed, 24 hours silent, perimeter without delay, total without delay
    Dual remote alert mode: Wifi/Internet and GSM 

    • The alarm system can transmit alerts to users in 2 ways, thus offering either the option to choose the most suitable way, or a redundant backup system, in case one of the connections is temporarily unavailable:
      1. via GSM, via SMS, and phone call to the phone numbers configured in the system;
      2. via Wifi/Internet to the dedicated application installed on the user’s smartphone.

    Protect your home automatically

    • Did you forget to activate the alarm system when leaving?
    • Did you get home from work and enter the house without disarming the alarm system?
    • Stay calm, Akyoto HSL077 has the option of automatic arming / disarming at the desired times depending on your schedule: leaving/returning from work, or why not even late at night / early in the morning using perimeter arming.

name: TP-Link VIGI C540 (4MM)
description:
The TP-Link VIGI C540 4MP Outdoor Full-Color Pan Tilt Network Camera delivers sharp 4MP resolution with 24-hour full-color monitoring via high-sensitivity sensors and built-in LEDs. Featuring pan-tilt functionality for customizable patrols and auto-tracking, it enhances property surveillance.

Its IP66 rating ensures reliable outdoor use, while smart detection alerts for human presence, motion, and boundary crossings boost security. H.265+ compression optimizes storage and bandwidth without compromising quality, and dual power options (PoE/12V DC) make setup easy. Manage it conveniently with the VIGI app for real-time monitoring and control.

  • 4MP High Definition: The camera comes with 4MP–more than enough pixels to pick up some of the more discrete details.
  • 24h Full-Color: Obtain 24-hour color details, even in pitch-black conditions, via high-sensitivity sensor and included spotlight LEDs.
  • Powerful Pan Tilt: Customized patrol routes and auto tracking provide more intelligent options to monitor key areas and improve security within your property.
  • Waterproof: Reliable IP66 for stable outdoor performance.
  • Smart Detection (human detection, motion detection, area intrusion, line-crossing, video tampering): Receive notifications and check feeds when someone crosses a boundary, enters an area you’ve set, or obstructs the camera.
  • H.265+: Without using any extra bandwidth, your cameras transmit compressed crystal-clear video to save disk space, ease network loads, and reduce monitoring costs without sacrificing image quality.
  • PoE/12V DC:TP-Link VIGI C540 has two power supply ways not only give you more convenience but also make your wiring remarkably easy.
  • VIGI App: Manage your security from the palm of your hand with the VIGI app.

name: TP-Link VIGI C450 (2.8mm) 5MP
description:

It features human and vehicle classification, smart detection (intrusion, line-crossing), and people/vehicle analytics for improved search efficiency. Active defense with sound and light alerts, two-way audio, and Corridor Mode for narrow areas enhance security. H.265+ compression optimizes bandwidth and storage, while Smart Video Enhancement (Smart IR, True WDR, 3D DNR, Night Vision) improves image quality. It supports PoE/12V DC, flexible management via web UI, NVR UI, VIGI app, and local/SD card storage (up to 256 GB).

  • 5MP Super-High Definition: The Tp-link VIGI C450 5MP 2.8mm comes with 5MP–more than enough pixels to pick up some of the more discrete details.
  • 24h Full-Color: Obtain 24-hour color details, even in pitch-black conditions, with its large-aperture lens, high-sensitivity sensor, and attached supplemental lights.
  • Human & Vehicle Classification: Distinguishes humans and vehicles from other objects, so you receive more accurate event notifications.
  • Smart Detection: Actively detects abnormal events like area intrusion and line-crossing, sending notifications to you instantly.
  • People & Vehicle Analytics: Tp-link VIGI C450 2.8mm quickly find people and vehicles of interest using a series of attributes, allowing you to improve search efficiency§.
  • Active Defense: Warn potential intruders instantly with sound and light when abnormal events.
  • Two-Way Audio: With voice intercom support, carry two-way conversations while watching your feed from anywhere.
  • Corridor Mode: Allows you to change the image aspect ratio from 16:9 to 9:16, and helps to monitor long and narrow areas.
  • H.265+: Without using any extra bandwidth, your cameras transmit compressed crystal-clear video to save disk space, ease network loads, and reduce monitoring costs without sacrificing image quality.
  • Smart Video Enhancement: Tp-link VIGI C450 2.8mm professional technologies process videos to greatly improve their quality that is vital to your monitoring, including Smart IR, True WDR, 3D DNR, and Night Vision.
  • PoE/12V DC: Tp-link VIGI C450 2.8mm Two types of power supply not only give you more convenience but also make your wiring remarkably easy.
  • Flexible Management and Storage: Take full control over your security via four management methods: the web UI, NVR UI, VIGI app, and VIGI Security Manager. Local storage is available for each method, as well as onboard storage with SD card slot (up to 256 GB).
